messages:
luna: moved my whole WFH battlestation into the little alcove to catch golden-hour light. looks amazing but two problems: webcam glare and my MacBook keyboard is getting warm from direct sun. photo attached 📸
raj: oooo pics pls :eyes:
luna: uploading... (3 pics) — glare on the left monitor, keyboard like a solar panel ☀️💻
toni: looks cozy. first thought: cheap blackout curtain or a peel-and-stick window film. also a laptop stand (tilt) helps airflow.
michelle: clip-on USB fan is a game changer. i keep one on my docking station. also raise brightness of webcam backlight correction?
ben: don't duct-tape anything to the screen again :grimace: (speaking from past mistakes)
luna: 😂 noted. tiny hack i tried: taped a folded poster to the window frame as a temporary shade — less glare but still warm.
sam: if it gets flaky during meetings, hotspot your phone as fallback. also mesh wifi relocated to hallway helped my alcove coverage.
raj: is your ISP flaky or just heat related? netbot, any latency blips for luna's subnet?
netbot: [automated] On 2301122335 detected brief latency spike (~220ms) from ISP "NorthLight" in region us-west-2, duration ~2m. No packet loss reported.
michelle: oof. i had a similar spike last week when my router sat on top of a bookshelf exposed to sun — it throttled temps. router cools on floor now, no more spikes.
toni: cheap passive solutions: reflective notebook under laptop (elevate), ventilated laptop pad, or a bamboo laptop stand. aesthetic + function.
ben: pro tip: turn off keyboard backlight when in sun, saves battery and maybe heat? not sure on the heat part, but it helped my battery life.
luna: poll time: should i (1) keep alcove and DIY shade, (2) move back to old desk, (3) invest in blinds/curtain? vote with emoji — 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣
raj: 1️⃣ - super aesthetic, keep it
michelle: 3️⃣ - curtains = long term win
toni: 1️⃣ then 3️⃣ (if it gets worse)
sam: 2️⃣ - move if you need reliability for calls
ben: 3️⃣ for career-yawning blinds, but 1️⃣ for vibe
luna: thanks! will try a clip-on fan + temporary shade first. if meetings die tomorrow i'll be moving desks 😅
michelle: also if you want i can drop off an extra laptop riser this week (nearby).
luna: omg yes please, michelle, that would be amazing 🙏
netbot: [reminder] Weekly infra maintenance scheduled Sat 2301122400-2301126000 UTC — expect brief reconnects for on-prem routers.
raj: noted. good luck with the sun fort, luna ☀️ 
ben: post a follow-up pic after the fan/stand test — we need updates for the office aesthetics board 📸
